body: # Top 5 Australian Mining Stocks This Week: Australian Mines Shines on Scandium Scoping Study. Explore the news driving the week's best-performing ASX mining stocks, alongside the biggest updates in Australia’s resource industry. **Welcome to the Investing News Network's weekly round-up of the top-performing mining stocks listed on the ASX, starting with news in Australia's resource sector.**. This week’s list shows a diverse mix of commodities, led by scandium, nickel and gold developer Australian Mines as the top gainer. Read on to discover this week's top gaining Australian mining stocks on the ASX and what drove their share prices. In US dollars, gold decreased 3.31 percent, moving from US$4,709.75 on Monday to US$4,553.84 Thursday, and in Australian dollars it pulled back 2.95 percent from AU$6,590.47 to AU$6,396.25. ### Top ASX mining stocks this week. Take a look at this week’s five best-performing Australian mining stocks below as the Investing News Network breaks down their operations and why these companies are up this week.
